+import sqlite3
+
+
+DATABASE_PATH = \"inventory.db\"
+
+
+def adjust_inventory():
+    connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_PATH)
+    connection.isolation_level = None
+
+    try:
+        connection.execute(\"BEGIN\")
+        connection.execute(\"SAVEPOINT before_gadget\")
+        connection.execute(
+            \"UPDATE products SET quantity = ? WHERE name = ?\",
+            (8, \"Widget\"),
+        )
+        connection.execute(
+            \"INSERT INTO products (id, name, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?)\",
+            (4, \"Doodad\", 3),
+        )
+        connection.execute(\"RELEASE SAVEPOINT before_gadget\")
+        connection.commit()
+    except Exception:
+        connection.rollback()
+        raise
+    finally:
+        connection.close()
+
+
+if __name__ == \"__main__\":
+    adjust_inventory()
*** End Patch
